title: Kidney Learning — Pediatric CKD Clinic
summary: A front-end-only learning site for pediatric chronic kidney disease (CKD) education, showing progress through pre/post tests and radar charts against historical score distributions.
html:
Kidney Learning — Pediatric CKD Clinic

Tags: Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, Vitest, Vercel

Why

Pediatric CKD education often relies on paper handouts and verbal explanation. Clinic time is short, so it is hard to confirm whether patients and families actually learned. The teaching clinic wanted a lightweight tool, usable in the clinic or at home, that makes learning outcomes visible and comparable.

Goals and intended effect

  • Pre/post tests across five CKD knowledge areas so users can see their own progress.
  • A radar chart for per-area scores, plus a distribution chart placing the user against historical pre/post results.
  • No sign-up: open the URL and practice, keeping the barrier low.
  • A supporting teaching aid and outcome record, not a formal exam with anti-cheating requirements.

How it was built

  1. Collected clinical guidelines and education-program references, then drafted the topics, five practice questions and candidate answers.
  2. Converted historical pre-test (166) and post-test (162) spreadsheets into anonymous statistics with a Python script: score distributions, mean and median only, with no names or per-answer data.
  3. Isolated scoring (2 points per question, completion rate, score rate, tied-score median percentile) in its own module, covered by Vitest.
  4. Answers and drafts live in browser localStorage with JSON backup download; the repository interface leaves room for a cloud adapter later.
  5. Hash routing and fully static deployment on Vercel: no env vars, no backend.

Packages and models

  • Framework: Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite 7
  • Charts: hand-built SVG radar and distribution components
  • Icons: Lucide
  • Testing: Vitest, vue-tsc type checking
  • Data prep: Python + openpyxl (dev-time only)
  • Hosting: Vercel static
  • Models: no AI model at runtime; all scoring is deterministic code

Limitations

  • Records stay in that browser and origin; switching devices or clearing data loses them.
  • Client-side answers and scoring are inspectable, so it is unsuitable for formal exams.
  • Questions are a test version and need teacher approval before real use.

Links

  • Live site: https://frontend-two-chi-30.vercel.app/
  • Source: private repository (not public)

title: 腎入學習｜兒童 CKD 教學門診
summary: 協助兒童慢性腎臟病（CKD）衛教的純前端學習網站，以前後測與雷達圖呈現學習進步，並對照歷史成績分布。
html:
腎入學習 — 兒童 CKD 教學門診

Tags: Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, Vitest, Vercel

緣由

兒童慢性腎臟病的衛教多半停留在紙本與口頭說明，門診時間有限，家屬與病童難以確認「學會了沒有」。教學門診希望有一個能在診間或回家後使用的輕量工具，讓衛教成效可以被看見、被比較，並能作為教學評比的佐證。

目的與預期效果

  • 以 CKD 五大知識面向設計前後測，讓使用者了解自己的學習進步。
  • 用雷達圖呈現各面向得分，用分布圖把個人成績對照歷史前測／後測的中位百分位。
  • 不需註冊登入，開啟網址即可練習，降低診間使用門檻。
  • 作為教學門診的輔助教材與成效紀錄，而非有防作弊要求的正式考試。

如何做出來

  1. 整理臨床診療指引與衛教計畫等參考資料，擬定主題與五題練習題及候選答案。
  2. 將歷史前測（166 筆）、後測（162 筆）Excel 以 Python 腳本轉為匿名統計（僅分數分布、平均、中位數），不含姓名與逐筆答案。
  3. 計分邏輯獨立為 scoring 模組（每題 2 分、完成率、得分率、同分中位百分位），以 Vitest 撰寫測試。
  4. 作答紀錄與草稿存於瀏覽器 localStorage，可下載 JSON 備份；儲存介面預留 adapter，日後可接雲端資料庫。
  5. 路由採 hash，純靜態部署至 Vercel，不需環境變數或後端。

使用的套件與模型

  • 框架：Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite 7
  • 圖表：自繪 SVG 雷達圖與分布圖元件
  • 圖示：Lucide
  • 測試：Vitest、vue-tsc 型別檢查
  • 資料處理：Python + openpyxl（僅開發時轉檔）
  • 部署：Vercel 靜態託管
  • 模型：網站執行時不使用任何 AI 模型，所有計分皆為確定性程式邏輯

限制

  • 紀錄僅存於該瀏覽器與網域，換裝置或清除資料不會帶走。
  • 純前端的答案與計分可被檢視，不適合正式考試。
  • 題目為測試版，正式使用前仍須教師核定。

連結

  • 線上網站：https://frontend-two-chi-30.vercel.app/
  • 原始碼：私有儲存庫（未公開）

title: E-commerce Management Dashboard
highlights: Inventory management automation reduced manual errors by 60%
Real-time data synchronization and notification system
summary: A modern management dashboard for small and medium e-commerce businesses, integrating order management, inventory control, and data analytics.
html:
E-commerce Management Dashboard

Project Background

With the rapid development of e-commerce business, traditional management methods can no longer meet the needs of modern enterprises. This project aims to provide a complete management solution for small and medium-sized e-commerce businesses.

Core Challenges

1. Data Fragmentation

  • Order, inventory, and customer data scattered across different systems
  • Lack of unified data view
  • Insufficient decision-making basis

2. Efficiency Bottlenecks

  • Manual order processing is time-consuming and error-prone
  • Lack of inventory management automation
  • Missing real-time notification mechanisms

3. Scalability Limitations

  • Existing systems cannot support business growth
  • Multi-store management difficulties
  • Complex third-party integrations

Solution

Technical Architecture

Frontend (Next.js 15)
├── App Router
├── Server Components
├── Client Components
└── API Routes

Backend (Prisma + PostgreSQL)
├── Multi-tenant data model
├── Real-time data synchronization
├── Automated workflows
└── RESTful API

UI/UX (Tailwind + Shadcn/ui)
├── Responsive design
├── Accessibility support
├── Dark mode
└── Component-based architecture

Core Feature Modules

📊 Data Dashboard

  • Real-time sales data visualization
  • Multi-dimensional data analysis
  • Custom report generation
  • Trend prediction analysis

📦 Order Management System

  • Automated order processing workflow
  • Batch operation support
  • Status tracking and notifications
  • Return and exchange management

🏪 Inventory Control Center

  • Real-time inventory monitoring
  • Automatic restock alerts
  • Multi-warehouse management
  • Inventory warning system

👥 Customer Relationship Management

  • Customer data integration
  • Purchase behavior analysis
  • Personalized recommendations
  • Customer service ticketing system

Technical Highlights

1. Performance Optimization

  • Server Components: Reduced client-side JavaScript load
  • Incremental Static Regeneration: Ensured data freshness
  • Image Optimization: Automatic WebP conversion and lazy loading
  • Code Splitting: On-demand loading to reduce initial load time

2. User Experience

  • Intuitive Interface: UI design based on user research
  • Fast Response: Optimistic updates and local state management
  • Accessible Design: WCAG 2.1 compliant
  • Multi-language Support: i18n internationalization implementation

3. System Reliability

  • Error Boundaries: Graceful error handling mechanisms
  • Data Backup: Automated backup strategies
  • Monitoring & Alerts: System health monitoring
  • Security Protection: JWT authentication and RBAC permission control

Development Process

1. Requirements Analysis Phase (2 weeks)

  • User interviews and requirement gathering
  • Competitive analysis and market research
  • Technical solution evaluation
  • Project planning

2. Design Phase (3 weeks)

  • User experience design
  • System architecture design
  • Database design
  • API interface design

3. Development Phase (8 weeks)

  • Core feature development
  • Frontend-backend integration
  • Third-party service integration
  • Performance optimization

4. Testing & Deployment Phase (3 weeks)

  • Unit testing and integration testing
  • User acceptance testing
  • Performance testing
  • Production environment deployment

Project Results

Quantitative Metrics

  • Order Processing Efficiency: Improved by 45%
  • Inventory Error Rate: Reduced by 60%
  • User Satisfaction: Improved to 4.8/5.0
  • System Response Time: < 200ms

Business Value

  • Cost Savings: 30% monthly labor cost reduction
  • Revenue Growth: 25% increase in average order value
  • Operational Efficiency: 40% overall efficiency improvement
  • Customer Retention: 35% improvement in retention rate

Technical Challenges & Solutions

Challenge 1: Real-time Processing of Large Data Volumes

Solution:

  • Used PostgreSQL's LISTEN/NOTIFY mechanism
  • Implemented WebSocket connections for real-time data push
  • Adopted pagination and virtual scrolling for large list rendering optimization

Challenge 2: Multi-tenant Data Isolation

Solution:

  • Designed Row-Level Security (RLS) policies
  • Implemented tenant-level data encryption
  • Established comprehensive permission management system

Challenge 3: Third-party Service Integration

Solution:

  • Built unified API Gateway
  • Implemented retry mechanisms and circuit breaker patterns
  • Designed flexible configuration management system

Future Planning

Phase 2: AI Intelligence

  • Intelligent inventory forecasting
  • Personalized recommendation engine
  • Automated customer service chatbot
  • Anomaly detection system

Phase 3: Ecosystem Expansion

  • Mobile app development
  • Open API platform
  • Third-party plugin marketplace
  • Multi-channel integration

Learning & Insights

This project gave me deep understanding of:

  • Full-stack Development Complexity: Comprehensive consideration from user experience to system architecture
  • Performance Optimization Importance: Optimization strategies in big data scenarios
  • User-Centered Design: Product design thinking that truly solves user pain points
  • Team Collaboration: Communication and collaboration skills in cross-functional teams

html:
電商管理後台系統

專案背景

隨著電商業務的快速發展，傳統的管理方式已無法滿足現代企業的需求。本專案旨在為中小型電商企業提供一套完整的管理解決方案。

核心挑戰

1. 數據分散問題

  • 訂單、庫存、客戶數據散落在不同系統
  • 缺乏統一的數據視圖
  • 決策依據不足

2. 效率瓶頸

  • 手動處理訂單耗時且容易出錯
  • 庫存管理缺乏自動化
  • 缺乏即時通知機制

3. 擴展性限制

  • 現有系統無法支撐業務增長
  • 多店鋪管理困難
  • 第三方整合複雜

解決方案

技術架構

Frontend (Next.js 15)
├── App Router
├── Server Components
├── Client Components
└── API Routes

Backend (Prisma + PostgreSQL)
├── 多租戶數據模型
├── 即時數據同步
├── 自動化工作流程
└── RESTful API

UI/UX (Tailwind + Shadcn/ui)
├── 響應式設計
├── 無障礙支援
├── 深色模式
└── 元件化架構

核心功能模組

📊 數據儀表板

  • 即時銷售數據視覺化
  • 多維度數據分析
  • 自定義報表生成
  • 趨勢預測分析

📦 訂單管理系統

  • 自動化訂單處理流程
  • 批量操作支援
  • 狀態追蹤與通知
  • 退換貨管理

🏪 庫存控制中心

  • 即時庫存監控
  • 自動補貨提醒

技術挑戰與解決

挑戰 1: 大量數據的即時處理

解決方案:

  • 使用 PostgreSQL 的 LISTEN/NOTIFY 機制

title: Transcript Plus
summary: A local-first desktop app that turns recordings into editable transcripts, then subtitles and meeting notes, fully offline.
html:
Transcript Plus — Local Subtitle and Meeting Notes App

Tags: Tauri, React, Python, SQLite, Whisper, Offline

Currently a v0.1 development build: the desktop UI, local Python transcription core, SQLite storage, transcript editing and subtitle export are implemented. A macOS .app builds locally, but it is not a full MVP yet, and Windows hardware and public release are unverified.

Why

The idea came from speech-related development work: the real time sink turned out to be the manual work between "recognition finished" and "transcript ready": proofreading, line-breaking and timing, and few tools cover that whole stretch. Interviews, meetings and lessons also often contain sensitive material that should not go to the cloud. So I set out to try an installable single-machine app where data and inference never leave the computer.

Goals and intended effect

  • Take interviewers, podcasters, educators and meeting note-takers from a local media file to publishable subtitles.
  • Cut proofreading time: the target is at least 30% lower median subtitle-prep time on the same material (a planning target, not yet validated).
  • Work fully offline once models are in place, with no sign-up and no self-hosted server.
  • One transcript dataset yields TXT, SRT, VTT and JSON, plus (planned) summaries and action items.

How it was built

  1. Wrote the MVP requirements, acceptance metrics and architecture first to settle scope and tech choices, then built milestone by milestone.
  2. Architecture: Tauri 2 shell, React front end, Python sidecar core packaged with PyInstaller so users need no dev environment.
  3. A structured Transcript / Word / Cue data contract at the center; SQLite is the single writable source of truth and subtitle files are derived output.
  4. Persistent job queue with stage state, cancel and retry, autosave and undo/redo; invalidated word timings are flagged for review rather than faked.
  5. Two-hour transcripts render through a virtual list to keep editing responsive.

Done: media import and playback, local transcription with word timings, subtitle generation / split / merge / timing tweaks, TXT / SRT / VTT / JSON export. Not yet: automatic speaker diarization, local summaries and action items, video proxy, model download management, code signing and notarization.

Packages and models

  • Desktop: Tauri 2 (Rust), React 19, TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Virtual, Lucide
  • Core: Python 3.12, SQLite, PyInstaller
  • ASR: faster-whisper (CTranslate2, CPU INT8); MLX Whisper on Apple Silicon
  • Models: Breeze ASR (tuned for Taiwanese Mandarin) or Whisper-family models, from a local folder the user picks; the app never downloads weights itself
  • Planned: sherpa-onnx speaker diarization, local LLM summaries and action items
  • Testing: pytest, Vitest, Testing Library
  • Media: FFmpeg / ffprobe

Links

  • Source and README: https://github.com/awtw/transcript-plus

title: Transcript Plus
summary: 以逐字稿為核心的本機字幕與會議整理桌面軟體，離線轉錄、校對並匯出 SRT／VTT。
html:
Transcript Plus — 本機字幕與會議整理軟體

Tags: Tauri, React, Python, SQLite, Whisper, Offline

目前為 v0.1 開發版：已實作桌面介面、Python 本機轉錄核心、SQLite 儲存、逐字稿校對與字幕匯出；macOS 已可建置 .app，尚非完整 MVP，Windows 實機與公開發行尚未驗收。

緣由

靈感來自工作上開發語音相關功能的經驗：發現真正耗時的不是辨識本身，而是「辨識完成到整理完成」之間的人工校對、斷句與對時，市面上也少有能完整銜接這段流程的工具。同時，訪談、會議與課程錄音常含敏感內容，不適合上傳雲端。因此決定自己嘗試做成可安裝的單機軟體，資料與推論都留在電腦。

目的與預期效果

  • 讓訪談、Podcast、課程與會議整理者，從本機影音一路做到可發布字幕。
  • 縮短校對時間：目標是在相同素材下，字幕整理時間中位數減少 30% 以上（規劃目標，尚未達標驗證）。
  • 全程離線可用，模型備齊後可斷網工作，無註冊登入與自建伺服器。
  • 同一份逐字稿資料同時產出 TXT、SRT、VTT、JSON，以及（規劃中）摘要與待辦。

如何做出來

  1. 先撰寫 MVP 需求、驗收指標與架構文件，釐清範圍與技術選型，再依里程碑逐步實作。
  2. 架構採 Tauri 2 桌面外殼、React 前端、Python sidecar 核心，以 PyInstaller 封裝，使用者不需自備開發環境。
  3. 以結構化 Transcript／Word／Cue 資料契約為核心，SQLite 為唯一可寫事實來源，字幕檔只是衍生輸出。
  4. 持久化工作佇列與階段狀態，支援取消、重試、自動儲存與復原／重做；字詞時間失效時明示待核對，不假裝有效。
  5. 2 小時逐字稿以虛擬清單呈現，維持編輯流暢度。

已完成：影音匯入與播放、本機轉錄與詞時間、字幕生成／拆合／時間微調、TXT／SRT／VTT／JSON 匯出。 尚未提供：自動講者分離、本機摘要與待辦、影片代理、模型下載管理、簽章與公證。

使用的套件與模型

  • 桌面：Tauri 2（Rust）、React 19、TypeScript、Vite、TanStack Virtual、Lucide
  • 核心：Python 3.12、SQLite、PyInstaller
  • 語音辨識：faster-whisper（CTranslate2，CPU INT8）；Apple Silicon 另支援 MLX Whisper
  • 模型：Breeze ASR（台灣華語優化）／Whisper 系列，由使用者自行指定本機模型資料夾，程式不自動下載權重
  • 規劃中：sherpa-onnx 講者分離、本機 LLM 摘要與待辦
  • 測試：pytest、Vitest、Testing Library
  • 媒體處理：FFmpeg／ffprobe
